text: Business Combination Kiwi II Asset Acquisition On January 8, 2026, through our wholly owned subsidiary Janus Core, we acquired 100 % of the business operations (such transaction, the Kiwi II Acquisition ) of Kiwi II Construction, Inc., a California corporation, Kiwi II East Inc., a Tennessee corporation, and Metal Tech, Inc., a California corporation, (collectively, the Kiwi II Sellers ). In addition, the R3 sales channel includes new self-storage capacity being brought online through conversions and expansions. We have $65.0 in remaining capacity under our share repurchase program.
